notes.title: The release date is pushed further
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43689416/6631a9066e7a182386ccab8af5dd853d4a8db4e4.jpg

We have made good progress making the game, but due to other works we have had the release is pushed further a few months.

The gameplay of the second to last level is going to be finished this year, but the last level will be completed at earliest on February. Also out musics and sound effects still need a lot of work.

But rest assured, this game will be ready in few months. And we will NOT be using the players for game testing.

Sorry for the delay, we were a bit too optimistic.
